text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hmm… That wasn't the best, was it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky sighs at the sight of her time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Maybe I've been a little overzealous lately?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: If I want to get faster, I might need to do a little personal maintenance…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should take a drive on the highway to refresh myself. It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky seems to be getting tired—perhaps from running too many consecutive races. I should review her race schedule…
